propositions: Five recovered RP decisions (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed research across source, tests, ADR, and ticket history to preserve architectural intent and resolve implementation ambiguities before becoming tracked stories.

RP-02 owns ordered exact-match binding-store retirement recovery with durable tombstone semantics and a read-only construction/load/preview boundary; RP-03 consumes coherent post-recovery state without duplicating persistence.

RP-03 establishes scoped failure-handling with singular retry ownership (max 3 physical invocations, 15s cumulative sleep), authoritative Jira rate scopes, and a three-consecutive exhausted-outcome finite-pass fuse per endpoint family.
RP-04 centralizes operation-snapshot composition with explicit CLI > environment > project > user > default config precedence, non-secret subprocess envelope, and removal of Cloud adapter fallback.
RP-05 normalizes canonical package-data help for all 75 public top-level commands via a lazy stdlib registry, with pre-operation routing for overview/help/alias/unknown before config materialization.

RP-06 unifies code-review and plan-review gates under effective-policy discovery with approved applicability reversal, typed failure isolation (Option B), explicit authored-budget enforcement, and versioned discovery trace for --retry semantics.
